about.label: 01 — About
about.text: I'm Kike, fresh out of my Web Development degree with 9 months of real work under my belt. I'm comfortable on both sides: interfaces in React and servers in Node, Java or PHP, with databases that don't break (almost never). I adapt fast, I like to pitch ideas, and I talk to the team before a problem gets big.
